##Current shipping forecast##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the British Isles.


##Wind##

Northerly 2 to 4, veering east or northeast overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair but with a risk of mist and fog patches at first.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally poor in any mist and very poor in any fog patches at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast, 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the east of the area, soon veering east or southeast.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, showers later, possibly heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, occasionally moderate or poor in any showers later.
